relationships.subject: CGRP receptor antagonists
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP receptor antagonists are efficacious and well-tolerated drugs in migraine.

relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Monoclonal antibodies against CGRP or its receptor are used for the prophylactic treatment of migraine.

key_findings: Review: CGRP and tachykinins are pronociceptive while somatostatin is antinociceptive in peptidergic nociceptors.
CGRP antagonists and antibodies work in migraine, NK1 antagonists failed as analgesics, and SST4 agonists are promising.
